metadata.title: Imperial (UK) Cup to Milliliters Converter
metadata.description: Convert imperial/UK cups to milliliters (mL) using the standard 1 imperial cup = 284.13125 mL factor, with guidance on rounding.

introduction: Use this converter when a source uses imperial or UK cups and you need milliliters.
This tool assumes the imperial cup definition of 284.13125 mL per cup.
methodology: We apply the fixed relationship: 1 imperial cup = 284.13125 milliliters.
For regulated or lab use, rely on calibrated equipment and uncertainty-aware rounding.
how_is_calculated: Primary formula: milliliters = imperial cups x 284.13125
Example steps: enter cups, multiply by 284.13125, then round based on your requirements.

faqs.question: Is this the same as a US cup?
faqs.answer: No. The imperial/UK cup is larger (284.13125 mL). For US cups, use the US cup converter.

faqs.question: How should I round the result?
faqs.answer: For everyday use, rounding to 1-2 decimal places is usually fine; technical use should follow significant-figure guidance.
